acceptable_paraphrases: The average length is approximately 28.3 cm
On average, the lengths are around 28.5 cm
The mean length is close to 28.3 cm
critical_errors: use of inches or other non-cm units
mentioning a single value instead of an average
misconceptions: Reporting the exact length of one measurement as the answer
Using inches or another non-cm unit in the response
Ignoring the units and just providing a number
grading_notes: Points should be awarded for correct average values, appropriate use of cm units, and clear indication of averaging. Incorrect units or single value reporting should result in deduction.
